message: No detected input validation: The code uses argparse with some choices constraints but performs no schema, dtype, or value-range validation on the actual loaded data (features, labels, adjacency matrices).
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; data is loaded from local files via dataloader functions with no checksum or integrity verification.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The only filtering present is removing disconnected nodes (structural graph cleanup), not statistical anomaly detection or outlier filtering on training samples to defend against poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses joblib (imported in models.py) for model serialization but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading serialized models.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection in any part of the training code shown.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range validation or schema checks are visible in the inference data-flow path; argparse choices restrict CLI arguments but do not sanitize feature data passed to models.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks applied to model outputs before they are returned or used downstream.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses graph/tabular ML models (GCN, SVM, KNN, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
